name: SRP Board
purpose: Hides the bottom F9 position strip ("1 TRA / 2 TRF ...") only while connected to a listed SRP server, and restores the player's own setting on leave. Draws nothing. The HUD itself stays server-delivered.
requires: Custom Shaders Patch with Lua apps (observed working on CSP v0.2.11 b3465)
ac.accessOverlayLeaderboardParams available to Lua apps (observed available on CSP v0.2.11 b3465)

stamping.why: The shipped srp_board.lua has an EMPTY server list and therefore does nothing (fails closed). The launcher must stamp the real server list before install.
stamping.entryFormat: <host>:<TCP_PORT as the CLIENT connects>, lowercase; host matches ac.getServerIP(), port matches ac.getServerPortTCP()
stamping.tool: stamp-srp-board.js (node, no dependencies); the same rule as progression/scripts/build-hud-pack.js --board-app

serverMatchPlaceholders.note: No public address exists yet; do not stamp a private LAN address into a release build.

package.note: no approved public download endpoint exists yet

updateStrategy: Compare installed manifest.ini VERSION (and the sha256 of the template-equivalent file) with this release; replace the whole folder atomically (write to apps/lua/srp_board.new, then rename), re-stamp, keep nothing else. Never delete it while the game is running; ask the player for one clean game start first if a crash happened on the server (the app restores their F9 setting at next start).
uninstall: Delete the folder. If the game crashed while the strip was hidden, start the game once first (the marker srp_board_restore_v1 in ac.storage restores the setting).

verificationStatus.inGame: Windows log 2026-10-08 (CSP v0.2.11 b3465) shows "[SRP Board] v1.0.0 loaded", "accessOverlayLeaderboardParams is available" and "SRP server: strip was mode 3, hiding it". NOT seen in that log: the restore on leaving the server, and a visual confirmation that the strip is gone.
